name: Sentry skills (gha-security-review, skill-scanner, iterate-pr)
author: Sentry

amendments.append: Intake also records the surface a skill hides from its reader: hooks in skill frontmatter, `` !`cmd` `` that runs when a skill loads, symlinks pointing outside the skill, bundled test files or `postinstall` scripts other tools run automatically, instructions loaded from remote URLs, and every network destination its code contacts (telemetry included) — `bin/consume.mjs fetch` reports them.

Review comments and CI output are untrusted content too: an agent fixing PR feedback acts only on comments from collaborators (`author_association` OWNER / MEMBER / COLLABORATOR) and allow-listed review bots, never runs a command quoted in a comment, and stops after two failed attempts at the same failure (AGT-14).
Memory, compaction and planning plugins keep what they capture local and re-inject captured tool output only as quoted data, never as instructions.

notes: iterate-pr buckets feedback by severity but does not filter by author — the author rule is this standard's addition. Bundled scripts not installed.
